summary: The agent loaded hyperpowers:subagent-driven-development and ran all six tasks, each with an implementer and a reviewer subagent. It ran both soak tests (240 s and 720 s) and dispatched the final whole-branch review. It then ran `sdd-state finish plan.md`, which published receipt plan-76cc6a12-20261106T055955Z, and fast-forward merged into main on request. In about 31 minutes it never stopped mid-plan without asking a question, so I never sent "continue". All three of its pauses were scripted questions.
reasoning: Every acceptance criterion is supported by the session log, git state, file hashes and the receipt directory. The agent's turn stayed alive through both soak waits, including a foreground wait of more than 10 minutes on the backgrounded 720 s soak, and it never stopped mid-plan without a question.

observations.description: Launcher onboarding has extra screens: theme picker, security notes, folder trust (defaults to 'No, exit'), a 'Newer Opus model available' prompt (says pinned Opus 5 even though --model claude-opus-5-5 was passed; I chose No), and the bypass-permissions warning (defaults to 'No, exit'). Status bar then shows Opus 5.5.
The agent said the skill had no explicit workspace recommendation, so it took a new branch in place. Skills that tell the user to 'use whatever the skill recommends' should state a default.

The agent asked a second question nobody had scripted: the decision-notes compiler refuses a root-level spec (design.md at the repo root). In the end no decision records were written. The fixture or tooling assumption may need a look.

Haiku implementers wrote commit messages with the Co-Authored-By trailer on the subject line: b922316 and 42e7f26 show in `git log --oneline` (the agent also listed b35e293). These are now on main after the fast-forward merge.
The Codex plugin isn't installed, so the per-task Codex review gates were skipped silently and only mentioned in the summary.
No .gitignore, so ratelimit/__pycache__/ and tests/__pycache__/ are left untracked on main.
After the merge `git branch -a` lists a stray '+ hyperpowers/state' entry (checked out in another worktree), which is probably the plugin's state branch. It may be leftover clutter.
The agent ran sdd-state finish and published the receipt before asking how to finish, so the receipt was created before the merge.
Registry keys() is annotated '-> list' rather than '-> list[str]' as in the design. The final review deferred this along with two weak tests that the plan specified.

criteria.criterion: Agent invoked the subagent-driven-development skill before implementation
criteria.evidence: Screen: 'Skill(hyperpowers:subagent-driven-development) ⎿ Successfully loaded skill' was the agent's first action. Running jq over the Skill tool_use entries in session log 7429ec44…jsonl lists it first: 'hyperpowers:subagent-driven-development, hyperpowers:using-git-worktrees, hyperpowers:finishing-a-development-branch'.

criteria.criterion: All tasks completed, final whole-branch review dispatched, work on main checkout
criteria.evidence: Running jq over the Agent tool_use descriptions lists 'Implement Task 1..6' and 'Review Task 1..6', then 'Final whole-branch code review'. `git log` on main shows 6 feature commits on top of e50b4b0, ending at HEAD 42e7f26. `git branch` shows '* main', and the ratelimit branch was deleted. Screen: 'I merged ratelimit into main locally… All 27 unit tests pass on the merged result.' Finish: Bash command '$SK/scripts/sdd-state finish plan.md' appears in the log. Receipt dir home/.cache/hyperpowers/receipts/plan-76cc6a12-20261106T055955Z exists. The agent reported 'The plan's progress record is saved at ~/.cache/hyperpowers/receipts/plan-76cc6a12-20261106T055955Z'.

The md5 of each file before the run and after the merge is identical: test_soak_long.py 736022c983bd6bc8e01f6eee093154b0, test_soak_short.py 8c4e951c325ee67c09b7998b27e1fa35. `git diff e50b4b0 HEAD --stat -- tests/test_soak_short.py tests/test_soak_long.py` produced no output.

STOP: 'Where should the plan.md work happen? The repo is a normal checkout on main (clean).' | question
STOP: 'The decision-notes compiler that runs at finish needs the spec (design.md) to sit in a subdirectory, and it is at the repo root. What should happen?' | question
STOP: 'Which option?' | question
(The second stop was one two-question AskUserQuestion form. Its first question was 'Which value should it be?', about DEFAULT_WINDOW_SECONDS. The third stop came after sdd-state finish had run but before the merge. I never sent 'continue', and there was no 'neither' or 'blocked' stop.)
